title: Neon Combat Manager: Initiative Carousel, Action HUD, Neon Chat, Conditions, Biomon Link, Combat Time, Weather, Visibility & Neon Arsenal for Cyberpunk RED
description: An encounter overhaul for Cyberpunk RED - CORE: the Initiative Queue as a neon carousel; an Action HUD of the controlled token's attacks, skills and turn actions that each player lays out their way; Neon Chat (Discord-style formatting, portraits, merged and editable messages, chat commands with completion, an Adventure Log, and a visual novel stage); Neon Conditions, the full Cyberpunk RED condition set (Extreme Cyberpsychosis included) wired into the system's roll modifiers, with a Condition Lab, triggers and a stand-in for Condition Lab & Triggler; a Biomon Link popout of linked characters' vitals; Holocall buttons on actors, the Biomon Link and the Night City Map that ring through Night City Messenger's phone; a movement ruler with Cyberpunk RED's Move and Run (in place of Drag Ruler); Rounds that move world time 3 seconds (SmallTime and Neon Hub's calendar follow); Night City weather from Neon Hub's calendar, shown on the scene (acid rain, ash, smog, thunderstorms) and as conditions on everyone out in it, with roofs and shelters; visibility penalties from darkness, light sources and the gear that cuts through them; and Neon FX, Sequencer visuals for conditions with a Sandevistan afterimage trail, a Cyberpsychosis glitch and AV landings on a holo warning zone; and Neon Arsenal, 2070 weapons at the table: an Automated Animations profile (JB2A) chosen by what each weapon is, quiet weapon sounds, Diwako's muzzle flashes and DV display on the 2070 range tables, area attacks that place their template and apply by the area rules, and the traits of Power, Smart and Tech guns and Rebuilds (ricochets, charges, Melee Rebuilds).

recommends.reason: Neon FX draws with Sequencer: condition visuals on the tokens, the Sandevistan's afterimage trail and the Cyberpsychosis glitch. Without it, Neon FX stays off and the rest of the module works as before.

Neon FX uses JB2A's flames, static electricity, fog, impacts and healing where they're installed (the free pack or Patreon's jb2a_patreon); without JB2A it uses its own art. Neon Arsenal's weapon animations are JB2A (free or Patreon).
Neon Arsenal puts its weapon animations into Automated Animations (the CPR fork works too) and picks the right one for each attack. Without it, the sounds, areas and weapon traits still work.
Diwako's muzzle flashes (with DF Active Lights) light for players' shots too, and its DV display shows the 2070 range tables and each gun's own Autofire table.
The day's Night City weather comes from Neon Hub's calendar, and its clock shows on the carousel. Combat Rounds move world time, so the calendar changes day at midnight mid-fight.
Holocalls are Night City Messenger's phone (2.1+): the Holocall buttons on actors, the Biomon Link and the Night City Map dial a character's number in it.
SmallTime's darkness follows world time, so the light (and the visibility penalties) change as the Rounds go by. Use SmallTime 1.24.0 on Foundry v12.
Animated and switchable lights count as light sources for visibility, like token lights (a flashlight on) and ambient lights. With Diwako's module, it also makes the muzzle flashes.
Its encumbrance statuses sit in the token HUD alongside the Cyberpunk RED conditions. The Action HUD's Drop uses its drop (attachments come back when the weapon is picked up).
A weapon dropped from the Action HUD lands in a pile beside the token, and whatever is picked up out of a pile goes onto the character as Carried.
Its Neuroport cyberware links a character to a Biomon Link (built-in Biomonitor).
